claim: Patchline ships a continuous corpus refresh stream ingesting public commits with deduplicated incremental indexing. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the continuous corpus refresh claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make continuous-corpus-refresh-stream-gate`.
